The shared topic rwb.decision-record.v1 takes the same settings (ASM-0202; GAP-1985). Its ACLs are on sheet ACLs: all 19 services write it, and rwb-decision and rwb-reporting read it. fixes.old: Architecture v5 fixes three retry windows, 1 min, 10 min and 1 h, and RWB-PLT-N002-INF counts three retry topics per event topic. No source names a retry topic, so the name is left to the platform story and is not written here (GAP-0123; ASM-0200); a consumer binds to the retry topics through the outbox and inbox library and never by name.
fixes.new: Architecture v5 fixes three retry windows, 1 min, 10 min and 1 h, and RWB-PLT-N002-INF counts three retry topics per event topic. The retry topics are named <event topic>.retry.1m, <event topic>.retry.10m and <event topic>.retry.1h, and the dead-letter topic <event topic>.dlt, for example rwb.case.events.v1.retry.1m and rwb.case.events.v1.dlt (GAP-2052). The names are carried in the naming library (RWB-PLT-E1047); a consumer binds to the retry topics through the outbox and inbox library.
